title: 大阪杯の後に・遥かに高い走り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky wins the race with a performance that impresses even Symboli Rudolf, and then sets her sights on the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf vows to have a rematch with Maruzensky and declares her intention to surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Maruzensky's racing, which has fascinated many, has an altogether different effect on certain others…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder begin to feel that catching up to Maruzensky is a dream too far out of reach.
